title: Start Stamp
description: One start.json: the code as it was when a verify run began, and which request opened it. The core compares it with the code at finish; a route whose fingerprint changed in between gets no verdict ("code changed during the run").

opened_by.description: Which request opened the run. `--finish` finishes only runs `--start` opened; a run `--run` opened is finished by that request alone, and if it stopped first it can only be aborted.

selected.description: The validations this run reads, after --only.

validations_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the selected validations exactly as use-cases-bridge.yml wrote them (canonical JSON). `--finish` refuses to read reports when they no longer match.

routes.description: Every route's fingerprint at the start point.

files.description: SHA-256 of every linked and resource file at the start point, so a changed-during-the-run diagnostic can name the files.
